flags.reason: The helper constructing the advertised iMonotoneBlock contraction mapping is never called or appended, so each executed flow_unit contains only affine couplings and ActNorm.
prob_predictor never updates z or the running log probability inside its three-module loop, so the returned density ignores two modules and evaluates the remaining inverse at the wrong point.
Evaluation forward passes perform an in-place gradient update on all model parameters, making each score depend on its batch composition, batch size, and all previously evaluated batches.
The test-time parameter updates performed by evaluation_batch are not restored, so training after every fifth epoch continues from a model fitted on the test set and later checkpoints leak test data.

AUROC and AP are reported as separate maxima over score, negated score, absolute score, and squared score using test labels, leaking label information and allowing different post-hoc score definitions per metric.
All datasets are loaded from the author's absolute /home/author/ddpm/UniINN path, so the committed default dataset cannot be used from this repository without editing code.
The default checkpoint directory is absent and never created before torch.save, so a default run fails at the first evaluation checkpoint.

ActNorm.inverse adds the same log-determinant sign as forward while AffineCoupling.inverse subtracts its forward log-determinant, making the chained change-of-variables calculation internally inconsistent.
The test array is deterministically ordered with every anomaly before every normal sample, which severely confounds the stateful online test-time adaptation used during evaluation.
The download script stores MAT files in per-dataset subdirectories, but loadData expects flat data/<dataset>.mat paths, so downloaded data are not discoverable even after fixing the absolute root.
campaign and fraud are downloaded as NPZ files, while loadData unconditionally requests <dataset>.mat and calls scipy.io.loadmat, making those advertised datasets unusable.
The script names the downloaded dataset satimage/satimage.mat, whereas preprocessing is keyed to the distinct name satimage-2, so the download name and implemented protocol cannot coincide.
einops is imported by utils/utils.py during every main.py startup but is absent from requirements.txt, so the declared environment does not provide a required import.
The --lr argument omits type=float, so any command-line learning-rate override is a string and is rejected by torch.optim.Adam.
The misspelled cudnn attribute deterministirc silently creates an unused Python attribute instead of enabling deterministic cuDNN behavior as setup_seed intends.
UniINN accepts latent_dim but does not pass it to Encoder, so any nondefault value makes the encoder emit 32 features while the flow expects latent_dim features.
LearnableNormal detaches its latent input, preventing both prior and posterior base-density terms from training the encoder or flow toward the learned density.
There is no validation split or model-selection rule, yet test AUROC/AP are printed every five epochs, enabling epoch selection directly on the test set.
Checkpoint loading provides no map_location, so a checkpoint saved from the default CUDA path cannot be evaluated on a CPU-only machine.

The repository README contains only a title and acceptance claim, with no run command, data-layout instructions, experiment configurations, expected results, or explanation of the unusual test-time adaptation protocol.
